scientific_question: Can one low-capacity identity-free joint semantic program capture measured Ugi head, ester-arm and tail relationships that remain missing from the frozen amine-semantic decoder?

policy.semantic_weighting: equal component-family-triple mass within exact complete coarse program
policy.sampling: one joint categorical draw per attempt without rejection or retry

nonclaims: The joint semantic target contains only graph-derived integer morphology and chemistry counts; it contains no product, component, family, graph, SMILES or fragment identity.
The prior uses source-adjudicated measured Ugi training products only and does not access calibration or held-out product structures.
This artifact performs no molecular generation, model training, repair, retry, routing, oracle calls or candidate selection.
A train-derived semantic target does not establish generated-molecule realism until the paired method-blind experiment passes every frozen promotion gate.
